extracts.label: Extract One — Two colleagues discussing remote work
extracts.script:
A: Honestly, I love working from home, no commute, more focus time.
B: Really? I actually miss the office. I get distracted so easily at home, my cat, the fridge, everything.
A: I get that, but for me the quiet is exactly what I need to concentrate.
B: Fair enough. I think it really depends on how disciplined you are.

questions.q: Why does speaker A prefer working from home?
options: The office is too noisy for everyone

questions.q: What does speaker B say is a problem when working from home?

extracts.label: Extract Two — A manager giving feedback
extracts.script: Say naturally, as a manager speaking calmly to an employee: Overall your report was solid, the data was accurate and well organized. However, the conclusion section felt a bit rushed, I think it needed one more paragraph explaining the recommendations more clearly. Other than that, good work, keep it up.

questions.q: What does the manager say was good about the report?
options: It was accurate and well organized

questions.q: What does the manager suggest improving?

extracts.label: Extract Three — Two friends discussing a job offer
extracts.script:
A: So, are you going to accept the job offer?
B: I'm still deciding. The salary is great, but it means relocating to another city.
A: That's a big decision. Do you know anyone there?
B: Not really, that's what worries me most, starting completely fresh, no friends nearby.

questions.q: What is speaker B unsure about?
options: Whether the salary is high enough
Whether to accept a job that requires relocating
Whether to ask for a promotion instead

questions.q: What worries speaker B the most?
options: Not knowing anyone in the new city
